context: A mom calms her young son after a tumble
purpose: Teach: 尻/舌/裸/途端/ご存じ/突っ込ん/わざと/いまいち

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、公園で転んで、尻打って、舌噛んじゃった。
lines.en: Mom, I fell at the park and hit my butt and bit my tongue.
lines.style: Urgent, breathless report delivered in a tumble. Whimpering underneath but fighting to get the facts out. Voice cracks slightly on the worst parts.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: あらまあ、見せて。痛かったね。
lines.en: Oh dear. Let me see. That really did hurt.
lines.style: Immediate shift into safety. Gentle, close inspection tone. Warm hands-on attention. Voice settles him with its steadiness.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ケンくんがわざと突っ込んで来たんだよ、絶対。
lines.en: Ken bumped into me on purpose. I know he did.
lines.style: Accusatory but wavering—needs the world to make sense of the pain. Sharp on 'on purpose' then trailing into doubt. Seeking confirmation.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ご存じの通り、ケンくんもまだ加減を覚えてるところよ。
lines.en: Ken's still learning how to control his strength. That's just how six-year-olds are.
lines.style: Patient, level-headed explanation delivered without dismissing his hurt. Matter-of-fact, like she's reasoned through this before. Voice holds him steady.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: でもさ、急に視界が裸眼で歪んだ途端、もう泣きそうだったよ。
lines.en: But then everything went blurry all of a sudden and I almost cried.
lines.style: Vulnerability breaking through the report. Small, trembling admission. Slow on 'blurry'—the moment he realized he couldn't see right. Voice tips toward tears.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 今日はお家でゆっくりしようね。気分がいまいちだから絵本にしよ。
lines.en: Let's stay home and rest today. You're not quite yourself, so we'll read picture books instead.
lines.style: Close, quiet decision-making spoken as permission. No performance of comfort—just steady presence and a gentle shift toward quiet. Held warmth.
